import java.util.Scanner;

public class E {
    static final long MOD = 998244353L;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextLong();
        long m = in.nextLong();
        long L = in.nextLong();
        long R = in.nextLong();
        
        long total = R - L + 1;
        long oddCount = (total + 1) / 2;
        long evenCount = total / 2;
        
        if ((L % 2) == 1) {
            oddCount = (total + 1) / 2;
            evenCount = total / 2;
        } else {
            oddCount = total / 2;
            evenCount = (total + 1) / 2;
        }
        
        long cells = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            long result = powerMod(oddCount + evenCount, cells);
            System.out.println(result);
        } else {
            long result = (powerMod(oddCount + evenCount, cells) + powerMod(evenCount - oddCount, cells)) % MOD;
            result = result * powerMod(2, MOD - 2) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long powerMod(long base, long exp) {
        base %= MOD;
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        if (exp == 1) return base;
        long half = powerMod(base, exp / 2);
        if (exp % 2 == 0) {
            return half * half % MOD;
        } else {
            return half * half % MOD * base % MOD;
        }
    }
}
